component_name: MIL-SPEC 5-Ton Environmental Control Unit (ECU) for server thermal load
description: Certified MIL-SPEC (DoD 5000-7) 5-ton capacity HVAC/ECU unit to provide closed-loop temperature regulation for the on-board rugged compute rack during continuous off-grid kinetic operation.
vendor_selection_criteria: Must be listed on the DoD Approved Vendor List (AVL) for environmental control systems
Must provide NEMA-4X enclosure rating and integrated Modbus-TCP interface
justification: Thermal management is the sole remaining failure mode for sustained off-grid kinetic deployment. The ECU is required to maintain compute hardware within operational temperature envelopes (0°C - 45°C) while drawing power exclusively from the trailer's kinetic-energy-derived storage.
